description: Sublim Air-Conditioned Apartment, Renovated in February 2024 - Elegance and Comfort in the Heart of ParisA Prime Location in a Charming Pedestrian StreetEnjoy the serenity of a peaceful pedestrian street while staying in the vibrant heart of Paris. This beautiful ground-floor apartment offers a tranquil and refined setting, ideal for exploring the city while savoring the comfort of a perfectly designed space.The space🏠 A Spacious, Modern and Fully Air-conditioned Apartment Designed for Your Comfort🌟 Living Spaces:• 🛋️ Warm Living Room with Dining Area: A bright and warm space including a comfortable sofa bed for relaxing moments, as well as a dining table that can accommodate up to 6 guests, perfect for sharing meals in a friendly atmosphere.• 🍴 Fully Equipped Open Kitchen: Everything you need to prepare your meals, including a refrigerator, stove, oven, microwave, washer-dryer, Nespresso machine, kettle and toaster.🌟 Sleeping and Well-being Areas:• 🛏️ Two Elegant and Comfortable Bedrooms: Each bedroom is equipped with a cozy queen-size bed and its own television, offering a modern and relaxing atmosphere for restful nights.• 🚿 Three Modern Bathrooms: bathrooms with shower and toilet, functional and bright.🌟 Air conditioning: the apartment is fully air-conditioned to ensure your comfort all year round, especially during the hot Parisian summers.✨ High-end services and thoughtful details:• 🧺 Professional cleaning: the cleaning fee includes hotel-quality linens and towels, freshly changed before each arrival, and an impeccable cleaning service for ultimate peace of mind.• 📶 High-speed Wi-Fi: stay connected effortlessly, whether for work, sharing moments or streaming your favorite shows.• 🪟 Bright and elegant ambiance: tasteful decoration and modern materials create a sere
